title: Separate realtime chat WebSocket, OpenAPI chat, audio-frame, and subscription gateway boundaries
description: AstrBot live chat and OpenAPI chat routes combine WebSocket auth, per-connection session state, audio frame assembly, attachment conversion, queue subscription, and bot response persistence. Rust should keep this as a web gateway boundary rather than mixing it with WebChat transport, agent feedback, or provider streaming.

files.change: Track WebSocket session, auth user, subscriptions, and cleanup outside route functions.
Isolate PCM/WAV assembly and temp cleanup from chat gateway logic.
Separate OpenAPI chat/message/file DTOs from dashboard management DTOs.

criteria: Realtime WebSocket gateway code does not live in WebChat HTTP routes.
Audio frame handling uses path/temp/media boundaries.
OpenAPI chat routes authenticate and enqueue messages through typed gateway services.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-web && cargo test -p astrbot-platform && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
